hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with the afterInitialize flag set but a no-op callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are performed via the separate `initializePools()` function, which calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap logic is implemented; all swap callbacks are no-op stubs.
